purpose: PHP and Symfony development plus real Chromium and Panther browser tests.
limitations: Chromium may need --no-sandbox where the host prohibits sandbox namespaces. Use only for trusted development content.
Node is not included; request a separate capability when the project requires it.

changes: Add opt-in trust for a mounted proxy CA before dropping privileges; preserve workspace ownership.
8.4-trixie.migration: Compatible additive update. Mount one PEM certificate read-only and set LIBRARY_CA_FILE to its container path when needed. Root-owned workspaces can use PUID=0 and PGID=0 without bypassing the entrypoint.
